title: KestrelCare Claim Payment Recoveries
content:
## Purpose

A claim payment made in error on a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts plan is recovered from the repair facility that received it. The recovery is booked on the plan's history as a payment recovery entry naming the claim payment it recovers, and the amount recovered raises the coverage remaining, restoring the limit of liability.

## Booking tool: `recover_overpaid_claim_bcfb33cc`

This is an agent-side tool. The representative unlocks `recover_overpaid_claim_bcfb33cc` and then calls it. One call books one payment recovery entry naming the claim payment being recovered and raises the contract's coverage remaining by the recovered amount.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `service_contract_id` | reference number of the KestrelCare service contract the payment was charged to, as returned by the service contract lookup | identifier |
| `payment_txn_id` | reference number of the claim payment entry being recovered, as shown in the contract's service history lookup | identifier |
| `recovery_amount` | the amount recovered and restored to the limit | USD, 2 decimals, rounded to the nearest cent |

## Return

On success the recovery appears in the contract's service history, the coverage remaining shows the restored figure, and the receipt carries `status` (the string "recovered"), `warranty_txn_id` (reference of the new recovery entry), `payment_txn_id` (the payment recovered), `recovery_amount` (USD with 2 decimals) and `coverage_remaining` (the coverage remaining after the recovery, USD with 2 decimals).

*Illustration (hypothetical values):* a recovery of 200.00 on a plan showing 5130.00 of coverage remaining returns a receipt whose coverage remaining is 5330.00.
